which is a map of exactly what to attack to degrade pricing.

Edit an existing alert.

Without this the only way to move a target price was to delete and
recreate, which loses the alert's trigger history and cooldown state.

post.description:
Drop a browser subscription.

Signing out has to be able to detach the endpoint, otherwise the next user
of the device inherits the previous account's notifications.

also blocks it; this check makes the backend safe on its own.
